rv.q: White created a stunningly resonant work of theater that many will laud for a long time to come.

Whatever the structural complaints, the play succeeds on the terms that matter most: you care about these people before you understand why, and by the time you understand why, the caring has gone deep.

cn.t: Critics praise this poignant multi-generational family dramedy as truly engrossing and engaging, with strong reception for its West Coast premiere at South Coast Repertory.
